in_marathi.name: Deepankar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deepankar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deepankar is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘Deepa’ (lamp) and ‘Ankur’ (seed). It symbolizes the enlightening and nurturing aspects of knowledge and wisdom. This name was often given to children born during the Diwali festival, as it represents the deep, unending knowledge that is ignited in one’s soul, much like a lamp that illuminates the path.
